node.name: App Walkthrough
node.rich_text:
APP WALKTHROUGH
1. Launching the Application Run the Student Information System from Visual Studio.
The main window displays the student information form and the student records in a DataGridView.
2. Adding a Student Enter the following information: • Student ID • Name • Gender • Year Level • Program • Contact Number
Click the Add button.
The application validates the required fields and saves the new student to the MySQL database.
3. Viewing Students Student records are displayed in the DataGridView when the application loads.
4. Searching for a Student Enter a Student ID or Name in the Search field.
The DataGridView automatically filters the records based on the search text.
5. Updating a Student Select a student from the DataGridView.
Edit the information in the input fields and click the Update button.
The changes are saved to the MySQL database.
6. Deleting a Student Select a student from the DataGridView.
Click Delete.
A confirmation message asks whether the student should be deleted.
Click Yes to permanently remove the record.
7. Clearing the Form Click the Clear button to remove the information from the input fields.
8. Error Handling The application uses validation and try-catch blocks to handle missing information and database errors without crashing the application.
TESTING COMPLETED
The following features have been tested: ✓ Add ✓ View ✓ Search ✓ Update ✓ Delete ✓ Clear ✓ Required-field validation ✓ Database connection
